# devmatei

> Matei (devmatei). Full-stack developer from the Republic of Moldova building type-safe web apps, APIs, and open-source tools. Maintains make-a-wrapped, an open-source Wrapped generator for ListenBrainz, Last.fm, and Navidrome.
